cards.title: Bringing work back
cards.body: To bring a branch's commits into `main`, switch to `main`, then run `git merge <branch>`.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c footer
touch footer.html
git add .
git commit -m "Add footer"
git switch main
git merge footer
ls

cards.title: Fast-forward
cards.body: If `main` hasn't moved since the branch started, Git simply moves `main` forward to the branch's latest commit. That is a fast-forward.

check.question: You are on `footer` and want its work in `main`. What do you run first?
check.explanation: Merging brings work INTO the branch you are on, so go to `main` first.

exercise.prompt: The `footer` branch has a finished footer. Merge it into `main`.
